# A laya run: progress.jsonl with train/state.json as configuration.
# The last evaluation step is written three times in the log, the third
# with calibrated metrics; the duplicates merge.

exec trainstat jsonl -config $TESTDATA/laya/run/train/state.json $TESTDATA/laya/run/progress.jsonl
stdout '^mode: heads$'
stdout '^seed: 1$'
stdout '^data_sha256: d3b20407'
stdout '^Unit grad-norm assume=normal$'
stdout '^BenchmarkTrain/step=1 1 .* sec/step'
stdout -count=32 '^BenchmarkTrain/step='
stdout -count=12 '^BenchmarkEval/'
stdout -count=8 '^BenchmarkFinal/'
stdout '^BenchmarkEval/split=val/group=all/cal=temp/step=32 1 141 n '
stdout '^BenchmarkFinal/split=val/group=all/cal=temp 1 141 n 1\.0328973446325462 loss '
stdout '^BenchmarkRun 1 32 steps 2118 seqs 155852 tokens [0-9.]+ train-sec 1 done$'

# A run directory is read the same way, and the summary derives Best and
# Throughput from the Eval and Train results.
exec trainstat $TESTDATA/laya/run
stdout '^columns: \.file$'
stdout '^runs: 1 done, 0 stopped$'
stdout '^val-frac 0\.1: '
stdout '^Final/split=val/group=all/cal=raw +0\.4752$'
stdout '^Best/split=val/group=all/cal=raw +0\.4823$'
stdout '^Throughput +221\.2m$'

# Events: start lifts configuration, stop leaves done 0, and a
# bit-identical duplicate evaluation merges.
exec trainstat jsonl -config extra.json events.jsonl
cmp stdout events.want

# A duplicate evaluation that differs is an error.
! exec trainstat jsonl nondet.jsonl
stderr 'nondet.jsonl: object 2: Eval/split=val/group=all/cal=raw/step=2 differs from an earlier evaluation at the same step'

# An object with no event is one evaluation: Final results and no Run.
exec trainstat jsonl eval.json
stdout '^BenchmarkFinal/split=test/group=all/cal=raw 1 0\.5 accuracy$'
! stdout Run

# A configuration conflict is an error.
! exec trainstat jsonl -config conflict.json events.jsonl
stderr 'events.jsonl: config mode=lora conflicts with mode=full from .*conflict.json'

# Runs that record val-frac but share one validation set, as runs given
# a validation file do, need no note; runs with their own sets do.
exec trainstat same1.jsonl same2.jsonl
! stdout 'each seed has its own validation set'
exec trainstat same1.jsonl split2.jsonl
stdout '^val-frac 0\.05: '

-- same1.jsonl --
{"event":"start","val_sha256":"aa","options":{"seed":1,"val-frac":0.05}}
{"event":"eval","step":1,"split":"val","metrics":{"all":{"accuracy":0.5}}}
{"event":"done","step":1}
-- same2.jsonl --
{"event":"start","val_sha256":"aa","options":{"seed":2,"val-frac":0.05}}
{"event":"eval","step":1,"split":"val","metrics":{"all":{"accuracy":0.75}}}
{"event":"done","step":1}
-- split2.jsonl --
{"event":"start","val_sha256":"bb","options":{"seed":2,"val-frac":0.05}}
{"event":"eval","step":1,"split":"val","metrics":{"all":{"accuracy":0.75}}}
{"event":"done","step":1}
-- extra.json --
{"data": {"data_sha256": "abc"}, "seed": 2}
-- conflict.json --
{"mode": "full"}
-- events.jsonl --
{"event":"start","mode":"lora","seed":2}
{"event":"step","step":1,"loss":2.5,"ms":250,"seqs":8,"tokens":1024}
{"event":"step","step":2,"loss":2.25,"grad_norm":{"head":0.5},"ms":200,"seqs":8,"tokens":1024}
{"event":"eval","step":2,"split":"val","metrics":{"all":{"accuracy":0.5,"loss":1.5}}}
{"event":"eval","step":2,"split":"val","metrics":{"all":{"accuracy":0.5,"loss":1.5}},"calibrated":{"all":{"accuracy":0.5,"loss":1.25}}}
{"event":"stop","step":2}
-- events.want --
data_sha256: abc
seed: 2
mode: lora
Unit loss better=lower assume=normal
Unit sec/step better=lower kind=time
BenchmarkTrain/step=1 1 2.5 loss 0.25 sec/step 8 seqs 1024 tokens
BenchmarkTrain/step=2 1 2.25 loss 0.5 grad-norm-head 0.2 sec/step 8 seqs 1024 tokens
Unit accuracy better=higher assume=normal delta=abs
BenchmarkEval/split=val/group=all/cal=raw/step=2 1 0.5 accuracy 1.5 loss
BenchmarkEval/split=val/group=all/cal=temp/step=2 1 0.5 accuracy 1.25 loss
BenchmarkFinal/split=val/group=all/cal=raw 1 0.5 accuracy 1.5 loss
BenchmarkFinal/split=val/group=all/cal=temp 1 0.5 accuracy 1.25 loss
Unit train-sec better=lower kind=time
Unit done better=higher delta=abs
BenchmarkRun 1 2 steps 16 seqs 2048 tokens 0.45 train-sec 0 done
-- nondet.jsonl --
{"event":"eval","step":2,"split":"val","metrics":{"all":{"accuracy":0.5}}}
{"event":"eval","step":2,"split":"val","metrics":{"all":{"accuracy":0.25}}}
-- eval.json --
{"split":"test","metrics":{"all":{"accuracy":0.5}}}
